explanation: Nice exists because Amsterdam failed. The institutional questions that enlargement to the east made unavoidable, the size of the Commission, the weighting of votes in the Council and the extent of qualified majority, were on the Amsterdam agenda and were left over, in a protocol that said they would have to be settled before enlargement. The conference of 2000 settled them badly enough that the next treaty was begun immediately. The claim is that Nice is the second attempt at Amsterdam’s unfinished business, which is what both texts say of themselves.
